prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with shoulder injury after a parking lot collision. The patient had 3 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1203; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- The patient was treated for the same body area within the last two years, and that condition adds to the current complaints.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented after a low-speed collision in a parking lot with complaints of right shoulder pain and restricted range of motion. Over three visits, the injury was assessed as consistent with the mechanism of the crash, and the clinical course followed a typical pattern of gradual improvement, with visit frequency decreasing as symptoms eased. On examination, several findings support a soft tissue injury to the shoulder, while other orthopedic and neurological tests were within normal limits. The records also show a prior history of treatment to the same shoulder region within the last two years, and that earlier condition appears to contribute to some of the current complaints. Billing for the episode reflects single charges for each service, with no repeated or duplicate entries. Continued home exercise and over-the-counter analgesia were recommended, with follow-up as needed should symptoms return.
